Kill Darth Vader and the Empire is ''ours''.''"<br />"''You should have asked me ''yesterday''.|Shens pleads with Tohm as he dies|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Shens''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] from the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Shens came to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to graduate, attaining the rank of [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]]. He was a friend of [[Caul Gentis]] and [[Laurita Tohm]], the latter being the valedictorian of their Academy.

==Biography==
Shens, however, was also secretly a member of [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]]'s [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]], a hero of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who sought to take over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to stop the unending [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Imperial officers at the orders of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Shens and Caul, at Gentis's orders, locked Tohm inside a [[Imperial starfighter prototype|prototype]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]], attempting to keep him away from the opening battles of their coup. Though the initial attacks succeeded in both wiping out seventy-two Imperial officers and gravely wounding [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Shens was one of the masked assailants who was counterattacked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|threw]] a large piece of stone atop Shens and several others, crushing them beneath its weight. Tohm, who had escaped the fighter by engaging its [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection seat]], happened upon the wounded Shens, who grabbed his ankle and begged for his help. Tohm was horrified to find that his friend&mdash;not to mention Gentis himself&mdash;were traitors to the Emperor. He asked Shens why he hadn't been involved, and Shens told him that due to his deformities and success, he stood out too much and would have been noticed. Shens then begged him to kill Vader, but Tohm told him that he should have asked him earlier and shot Shens in the head, killing him.
